question: For accounts with weekly issuance frequency that received a loan in 1997 for less than 200,000 USD, calculate the average amount of their credit card withdrawals ('VYBER KARTOU') made in 1998, but only include those accounts whose total transaction volume (sum of all transaction amounts) in 1998 exceeded 50,000 USD.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(t.XCL_051) AS avg_withdrawal
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.XCL_035) = '1997'
  AND l.XCL_036 < 200000
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
  AND t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND a.XCL_001 IN (
    SELECT a2.XCL_001
    FROM account a2
    JOIN trans t2 ON a2.XCL_001 = t2.XCL_047
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t2.XCL_048) = '1998'
    GROUP BY a2.XCL_001
    HAVING SUM(t2.XCL_051) > 50000
  )
